en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a small European town, likely from the early 20th century. A tree‑lined unpaved road runs between two rows of low, gabled houses with tiled roofs and dormer windows. Children stand and play in the street while adults walk or ride in a horse‑drawn wagon. There is a small kiosk or telephone/guard booth near the center. On the right-hand side, one of the houses bears a painted wall sign, suggesting it is an inn or guesthouse.
